meta.note: Runs of 2–3 contiguous lots on one block face that fit the dimensional rules as of right when combined, where the City lot alone doesn't. Combining lots needs a lot consolidation and the owners' agreement; this is not an offer, and it hasn't been checked with the City. Owner type only; never names.
meta.corners: handled: an outer side on a street takes the exterior side setback, as the citywide classifier does
meta.built_neighbours: not partners (buying or demolishing a home is a different decision); an open question, not a silent exclusion
